summary: SPAR Group filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, reporting a Settlement Agreement and Release with Robert G. Brown and SPAR Business Services, Inc. executed May 1, 2026. The settlement dismisses an arbitration action and extends the expiration of a Change of Control, Voting and Restricted Stock Agreement from January 28, 2022, to January 28, 2028, while releasing certain terms. No financial terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a legal settlement modifying a governance agreement, not a fundamental corporate transaction. Watch for arbitration resolution impact on governance and potential future control-related filings.
